fields.name: ArgentSea.Orleans.Pg membership table, gateway list provider and clustering registration
fields.contract: ArgentSea.Orleans.Pg.ArgentSeaOrleansMembershipTable implements IMembershipTable over the PgDatabases entry named by OrleansDbPersistenceOptions.DatabaseKey (construction throws KeyNotFoundException when it is missing) for the configured ClusterOptions.ClusterId: InitializeMembershipTable(true) creates the version record once; InsertRow and UpdateRow return true on success and false on a concurrency conflict; ReadAll and ReadRow return the membership data; UpdateIAmAlive changes only the liveness time; CleanupDefunctSiloEntries and DeleteMembershipTableEntries remove rows. ArgentSea.Orleans.Pg.ArgentSeaGatewayListProvider implements IGatewayListProvider from ClusterClientDbOptions (an explicit ConnectionString, else the read connection of the PgDbConnections entry named by DatabaseKey with global settings applied; an unknown key throws ArgumentException), with MaxStaleness from MaxRefreshInterval and IsUpdatable true. PgClusteringExtensions.UseArgentSeaPgClustering registers the membership table (and, on a client, the gateway list provider) as singletons with the ClusterOptions validator.
